families.name: PokeA_CompletePicketBridge
families.note: Seven-tile timber span with close pickets, caps, deck, beams and four inferred bank piles.

families.name: PokeC_DownstreamStoneBridge
families.note: Downstream uncovered bridge: dark masonry, three principal arch bays and small end openings, pale slab paving, solid brown timber guards.

families.name: PokeD_FourArchBridge
families.note: Four long arches, broad cobbled carriageway, pale solid parapets and rounded pier noses; complete 20-tile scene in one file with two internal halves.

families.name: PokeD_SingleArchBridge
families.note: Southern short river bridge; single arch, cobbles and matching parapets.

families.name: PokeD_StoneOverpass
families.note: Eastern short arched road overpass. Terrain approaches, side stair and nearby lower terrace remain separate.

families.name: PokeF_PondSlatCrossing
families.note: Four broad planks across the pond neck, with visible gaps and end fasteners; underside stringers inferred.

families.name: PokeH_FarmPicketBridge
families.note: Image clips the far end. Visible 128-pixel span is completed to a symmetric ten-tile bridge; full unseen length is an explicit estimate.

families.name: PokeI_ArchedTimberBridge
families.note: Upper west river crossing: shallow bowed timber deck with pale close-spaced rails. Uses later building calibration of 9.5 displayed pixels/tile.

families.name: PokeI_FlatTimberBridge
families.note: Lower west crossing; shorter and flat, with paired pale timber rails.

families.name: PokeI_NarrowPlankBridge
families.note: North-south central crossing with broad transverse plank joints and low edge beams. Rotate this X-running model 90 degrees.

families.name: PokeM_DiagonalDeckBridge
families.note: Gold diagonal-board deck, timber border and four light metal L-corner plates. Hidden beams/short bank supports inferred; no rail added.

families.name: PokeP_GullyPlankBridge
families.note: Repeated east-west gully crossings: six-tile deck plus bank-anchor margin, three independent-looking posts at each corner; no connecting rails.

families.name: PokeP_ShortGullyBridge
families.note: Shorter north-south five-tile crossing, same construction; rotate 90 degrees. Adjacent gray diagonal ramp is terrain stairs, not part of this bridge.

families.name: PokeS_IvyStoneBridge
families.note: Eastern pale garden bridge over water: slab paving, single open arch, solid coping and ivy. Other pale linear details are garden walls/edging, already covered.

families.name: PokeT_TubularRailBridge
families.note: Eight-tile timber crossing with rounded metal hoop rails. Northern/southern horizontal copies and the two vertical views reuse this model with rotations.

families.name: PokeU_ShortIslandBridge
families.note: Upper floating-island crossing, four broad plank sections; low underside ties and bank anchors inferred, no handrail.

families.name: PokeU_LongIslandBridge
families.note: Lower crossing is six plank sections long. Shallow sag and hidden ties inferred; same source palette as upper span.
